cross_source_conclusion: The claims address different mechanisms and conditions. One documents recovery/disruption tradeoffs; the other demonstrates author-side repair on flagged failures but has no repaired clean controls in that study. Neither establishes unconditional O improvement.
new_analysis_scope: Our100 manifest IDs and rep1 are a different prespecified denominator from the paper120/55/three-repeat headlines. The48 observed paired failures support21 located versus10 resample recoveries;52 missing policy pairs include51 baseline successes and1 failure. Do not present paper net success as reproduced by this slice.

paper1.configuration: Learned critic, threshold0.6; rollback/append with or without calibration; Qwen3-8B, GLM4.7 and MiniMaxM2.1 on HotPotQA100, GAIA30 and ALFWorld202.
paper1.contradictions: Section4 mixes the pilot rollback+4.7pp with a full-set sentence despite Table4 showing5.8 to7.9; its d/r<1 shorthand cannot replace the prevalence-weighted inequality when failure/success denominators differ. Preserve the distinct configurations.
paper1.identity: Vasudev, Russak, Bikel and Alshikh, Accurate Failure Prediction in Agents Does Not Imply Effective Failure Prevention, arXiv2602.03338v1
paper1.interpretation: Accurate detection alone does not determine task benefit. Paired net change is (recovered-disrupted)/N, equivalently p*r-(1-p)*d.
paper1.release_limit: No eligible author-linked per-episode release was located within the fixed official-source hyperlink search; global nonexistence was not established.
paper1.source_results: Table4 reports Qwen ALFWorld baseline5.8%, uncalibrated append8.6% (+2.8pp); HotPotQA/GAIA have no positive best intervention gain. These are task/configuration-specific aggregates, not the pilot or O outcomes.

paper2.configuration: Section10 organic booking, qwen2.5:7b serving temperature0.2; deterministic checks trigger live rollback, with author oracle task grading. Reported repair cells average three repeats over55 wrong flagged episodes, within120 episodes.

paper2.limitations: Absence of correct flagged episodes does not test repair on initially successful trajectories. The separate25-case injected alarm/repair matrix measures different conditions and is not pooled here. Checks were developed using serving-arm failures; held-out detection is distinct from held-out repair.
